verdict.rationale: Gemini Notebook is a SaaS product, so offering registrable outbound HTTP webhooks is a fair question and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents webhooks, event subscriptions, or any programmatic callback mechanism. The documented features cover source ingestion, chat, generated artifacts, sharing, exports and delayed generations, none of which is an event-subscription capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
